title: Message vs Call Mix Across Time Zones
dataSources: Shared calendar events (`sharedcalendar:event`), gift budget items (`giftbudget:item`), touchpoint logs (`touchpoint:log`), and relationship rituals (`relationship:ritual`).
app: Relationship and togetherness telemetry from shared calendars, gift budgets, message and call logs, and long-distance touchpoint trackers sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=touchpoint:log
| search timezone_gap_hr=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as touchpoints by _time channel
| sort - _time
description: Tracks message versus call mix over time and breaks it out by channel.
value: Channel mix across time zones shows whether the communication method still fits the distance and schedules involved.
implementation: Send message versus call mix events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1w granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of message versus call mix by channel.
grandmaExplanation: It lists how message versus call mix changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
